author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Story(?): The castles are at their last laid bricks. With reinforcements, new passageways, and outside protections, the two castles are at warfare and the only way to prevent further fallout is to capture their flag, therefore crumbling their empire. From the years of torment throughout the battlezones MCZone and Avicus, it's up to you to fight for your allies.

Worth a shot. You go to the enemies base where the red pad is, run through, and run back to place the wool in the location of the normal divines, above spawn. With a more dark atmosphere and a castle overhaul for CTF, we hope this plays alright, or well enough at least...

Specifics:
You cannot place blocks in your castle (marked by redstone).
You cannot build outside the area of the map itself.
No supply chests other than the health potions.
More obstacles so you have a better chance of killing the carrier.
   Multiple pathways, reasoning for balancing.
   Teamwork will be vital, reason for balancing.

Loadout:
- Iron Sword
- Leather Armor
- Bow
- 24 arrows
- Golden Apple
- 64 Cobblestone
- 16 Logs
- Iron Axe
- 64 Cooked Fish
- Iron Pickaxe

Teams: Red vs. Green

replies.author: Glitchaye
replies.body:
Alright, Ill break this map down and explain why I personally find that this map is a horrible redux.

1 : "You cannot place blocks in your castle (marked by redstone)." Why? In Runescape, you could place these items called "Barricades" they took a lot of damage to destroy, and they would block your movement. If used correctly, someone would be an absolute monster at defense, so taking away the ability to place blocks in the castle area destroys defenders.

2 : The Map's design. In the original game aswell, the teams had a distinct environment. One side, "Zamorak" had a much darker tone to it, all the ground was brown/dark and the opposite team "Saradomin" was a lushous green environment to show the "Good vs. Evil" aspect of the battle. It was two gods that were at war. Not 2 kings. And also, the tunnels under the map seem to be removed. WHY? They provided a much more stealthy approach to the flag. and defending that part of the map could change who won the match in some cases. Also the lack of ANYTHING in the middle island over the lava is just an eyesore.

3 : The team names : Its supposed to be 2 gods, Zamorak and Saradomin. Not 2 kings (Thats what I'm implying) and thats what gave the map it's character.

4 : Lack of supply chests. : In Runescape, under the main spawn room, there would be respawning items such as Pickaxes, Tinderboxes, Exsplosive potions, and Barricades. This also helped the opposite teams offense. Because, if the enemy team held down the supply room, the defenders couldnt restock their barricades or anything of the sort. So getting rid of these just makes it a plain CTF map.

5 : The way that CTF is coded ATM doesnt work with how the map works. In RS, you have 20-25 minutes to score as many flag caps as you can, with the team with the most, winning. In this maps current state, it's whoever caps first wins. And that's just boring.

TLDR : Research the map's origin before you redux it.
